body_text:
A conjecture is a precisely formulated statement believed or
proposed to be true but not established in the theory under
discussion. Evidence, computation, and agreement with known
special cases may motivate a conjecture, but they do not change
its logical status. A counterexample disproves a universal
conjecture immediately.
